title: Satisfiability from an Existential Prefix
statement: Let $m$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables, let $j$ and $i$ be natural numbers, and let $\sigma$ be a Boolean assignment. If the prefix of $j$ existential quantifiers starting at index $i$ is true under $\sigma$, then $m$ is satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a CNF formula over natural-number variables
The length-$j$ existential prefix starting at $i$ is true under $\sigma$
